content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli (Multi-disciplinary Research Unit)
Department of Health Research - Indian Council of Medical Research, New Delhi

Project Research Scientist II (Research Scientist C) - Non-Medical; Project Research Scientist I (Research Scientist B) - Non-medical; Project Technical Support - II (Laboratory Technician); Data Entry Operator
By email, followed by a walk-in interview for eligible candidates

content_sections.heading: About the Research Unit
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, located at Munshiganj, Rae Bareli – 229405, Uttar Pradesh. Its Multi-disciplinary Research Unit runs the ICMR project for which these posts are advertised, under the Department of Health Research - Indian Council of Medical Research, New Delhi. The notice is signed by the Nodal Officer of the unit.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists four posts and the pay for each. It prints no number of posts against them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification, as printed in the notice. The notice prints no age limit for any of the four posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Project Research Scientist II (Research Scientist C) - Non-Medical
rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification Experience, preferably in Medical Genetics / Molecular Biology / Biotechnology from a recognized university OR PhD.
rows.desirable: Preference to candidates having experience of working on MS Office computer applications.

rows.post: Project Research Scientist I (Research Scientist B) - Non-medical
rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, preferably in Medical Genetics / Molecular Biology / Biotechnology from a recognized university.
rows.desirable: Preference to candidates having experience of working on MS Office computer applications.

rows.essential_qualification: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field, OR Three Years Graduate degree (BSc-MLT) + two years' experience in laboratory.
Graduate in any discipline with knowledge of computer applications with data entry work, Diploma or degree in computer applications, and typing speed of not less than 8000 key depressions per hour.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The three posts other than Data Entry Operator carry 10% HRA on top of the printed pay. The notice prints Rs. 20,000 for the Data Entry Operator and mentions no HRA for that post. All four appointments are on a temporary contractual basis in the ICMR project. The length of the contract is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raebareli Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the application format given as Annexure - 1 in the notice, headed "Application for the post of", and write the post applied for. Fill in the applicant's name, father's or guardian's name, mother's name, date of birth, PAN number, Aadhaar number, address for correspondence and contact number. Fill in the education details (board or university, course, year, percentage of marks, division) and the experience details (institution, post, duration), if any. Paste a recent photograph on the form and sign it. The form carries a note on a declaration by the candidate and a list of documents to be submitted. Attach a passport size photo and self-attested copies of all relevant documents, including degree and experience. Send the application by email to [email protected] by 7 December 2026, up to 5 PM. The notice does not give a subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be called for a walk-in interview. The notice says the date of the interview will be informed through mail, and it also states that the interview is on 17 December 2026 from 10.30 AM onwards. The venue is not specified in the notice. Candidates should come with all original documents and a valid photo ID at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Raebareli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application is to be emailed by 7 December 2026, up to 5 PM, to [email protected].

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for the AIIMS Raebareli ICMR project posts?
faq.answer: Send the application in the Annexure - 1 format, with a passport size photo and self-attested copies of all relevant documents including degree and experience, by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist II (Research Scientist C)?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification experience, preferably in Medical Genetics / Molecular Biology / Biotechnology from a recognized university, OR PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist I (Research Scientist B)?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, preferably in Medical Genetics / Molecular Biology / Biotechnology from a recognized university. Preference goes to candidates with experience of working on MS Office computer applications.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Project Technical Support - II (Laboratory Technician)?
faq.answer: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field, or Three Years Graduate degree (BSc-MLT) + two years' experience in laboratory.

faq.question: Q6. What is the eligibility for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: A graduate in any discipline with knowledge of computer applications with data entry work, a diploma or degree in computer applications, and typing speed of not less than 8000 key depressions per hour.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Research Scientist C gets Rs. 67,000 + 10% HRA, Research Scientist B gets Rs. 56,000 + 10% HRA, Laboratory Technician gets Rs. 20000/- + 10% HRA, and Data Entry Operator gets Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes for the first three posts, where the pay is printed as "+ 10% HRA". For the Data Entry Operator the notice prints Rs. 20,000 and mentions no HRA.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on a temporary contractual basis in the ICMR project.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview and what should I bring?
faq.answer: The interview is on 17 December 2026 from 10.30 AM onwards. Bring all original documents and a valid photo ID.
